cis_text.title: Use a Passive Asset Discovery Tool

ai_guidance.llm: Focus passive discovery on parsing application and cloud logs for model interaction signatures, since AI softwareassets rarely generate the distinct network artifacts captured by traditional DHCP listeners. LLMs, especially LLMs used through APIs from major SaaS providers of AI services, can be a data protection risk and may only show up in their interactions with other systems since they are changing so fast that active discovery may not have methods to probe them.
ai_guidance.agent: Deploy passive network monitoring to detect traffic patterns indicative of agent communication, such as high-frequency API calls to model endpoints, MCP servers, or vector stores. Passive discovery helps identify “silent” or unmanaged agents that do not respond to active scans but are actively communicating with external tools or internal data systems.
ai_guidance.mcp:
Passive network analysis identifies MCP communications across enterprise segments. Focus on session initialization and capability negotiation messages to confirm exposed server features. Monitor authentication and authorization events associated with MCP access.

Alert on unknown or unauthorized MCP endpoints and on unusual volumes or sequences of tool invocation. Alert on anomalous tool invocation sequences (new tool names, unusual call order, high-frequency bursts), and on authentication failures that indicate enumeration or replay.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
CIS claims (cis_claims and cis/safeguards) use ATT&CK Enterprise 19.1, the version that the CIS mapping uses.

ATLAS results describe the ATLAS release in versions.atlas, pinned by commit and digest. ATLAS changes often: a later release can add techniques and mitigations. An empty mitigation list means that this release links no mitigation, not that no mitigation exists. agent_related is derived by this project from names.
